name: npm-cli-pin
description: Hash-pinned npm CLI for sdk publish. Node 22 ships npm older than 11.5.1, the first release that can do GitHub OIDC trusted publishing. npm 11.21.0 still vendors brace-expansion 5.0.9, ip-address 10.5.0, undici 6.28.0, and http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 inside its tarball; overrides cannot replace those inBundle copies. The direct dependencies below are the patched releases, and postinstall copies them over the bundle. The lockfile records the published pins so dependency scanners see the tree CI actually runs. http-cache-semantics has no release after 4.2.0, and npm ci rejects any other bundled version, so that entry stays 4.2.0 while postinstall copies the local patch (GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp).
